publishedfiledetails.title: Boss Indicators
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Tired of chasing after bosses or want to know if they're near? Then look no further.

[h1]What this mod does[/h1]
This mod adds a player-like indicator to bosses to know if they're lurking around, so that you can go and smack them in their face - or run away from them before they get too close.

This indicator can display bosses up to 3 - 4 screens away, their distance being related to the size of their icon (larger icon = closer).

Currently the following bosses are tracked:[list]
[*]Deerclops
[*]Dragonfly
[*]Bearger
[*]Moose/goose
[*]Antlion
[*]Ancient Guardian
[*]Toadstool (both cap and actual boss)
[*]Klaus
[*]Loot Stash[/list]

If you find a bug, have a suggestion or just like this mod, feel free to leave a comment.

publishedfiledetails.title: [Tips]Show attack time for hounds and bosses
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1] function [/h1]
To prompt the attack time of the hound (worm) and the Boss. The coordinates will be displayed when the Boss already exist. If not, it indicates that the Boss doesn’t fit the conditions for generation.
[list]

[*] To display the attack time of the hound and the Bosses of four seasons.
[*] To display the refresh time of the designated creature when instructions are given in the chat window.
[*] The time is in dd:mm:ss format.
[/list]

[h1] instructions [/h1]
[list]
  [*]/help tips [to display parameters of tips]
  [*]/tips hd [to display the attack time of the Hound (Worm when in the caves)]
  [*]/tips pm [to display the attack time of the Prime Mate]
  [*]/tips dr [to display the refresh time of the No-Eyed Deer]
  [*]/tips dc [to display the attack time of the Deerclops]
  [*]/tips bg [to display the attack time of the Bearger]
  [*]/tips ks [to display the refresh time of the Loot Stash]
  [*]/tips mt [to display the refresh time of the Malbatross]
  [*]/tips tt [to display the refresh time of the Toadstool]
  [*]/tips ck [to display the refresh time of the Crab King]
  [*]/tips al [to display the time when the antlion gets Antlion]
  [*]/tips df [to display the refresh time of the Dragonfly]
  [*]/tips ag [to display the cool-down time of the Ancient Gateway]
  [*]/tips bh [to display the growth time of the Honey Patch]
  [*]/tips lp [to display the cool-down time of the Rift Cycle]
  [*]/tips dw [to display the refresh time of the Nightmare Werepig]
  [*]/tips dw2 [to display the refresh time of the Scrappy Werepig]
  [*]/tips wr [to display the refresh time of the W.A.R.B.O.T.]

  [*]/tips pt [to display the coordinates of the player]
  [*]/tips sx x [x is a variable to change the position of UI. If x=0, the UI will be in the center; if x>0, its position will be changed to the right; if x<0, to the left.]
  [*]/tips sy y [y is a variable to change the position of UI. If y=0, the UI will be in the center; if y>0, its position will be moved up; if y<0, moved down.]
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Boss Attack Predictor
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Predict boss attack/respawn with displayed timer in a widget.
Also will display the time of Ruins Regeneration and Ancient Gateway Cooldown

Has same features as Hound Attack Predictor, and additionally also predicts Rift cycles

It will show the bosses who attack
- Antlion
- Bearger
- Deerclops
And the bosses who spawn
- Bee Queen
- Crab King
- Dragonfly
- Fruitfly
- Malbatross
- Klaus
- Toadstool
- Nightmare Werepig
- Scappy Werepig
And some extra timer
- Gateway Cooldown
- Ruins Reset

PS. Lord Fruit Fly is the least useful timer in this mod, the spawn mechanic does not depend on the timer but the plants you farm, so I suggest you disable it.

This mod is compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2885137047]UI Drag Zoom[/url] mod. You may freely drag the widgets if that mod is installed.

Note on mod configuration:
This mod uses client configuration when you join a server. If you are joining a game instead of hosting, you can change client configurations in the main menu > "Mods"; by "main menu" I am referring to the menu where there are buttons for "Browse Games", "Host Game", "Item Collection", etc. This way, different players on the same server may customize differently according to their own preferences.

GitHub: https://github.com/SperenzaNarra/dst_boss_atk_pred

publishedfiledetails.title: Boss Calendar Lite
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Calculate and remember when bosses respawn.

Support click-announcing and auto-reminding.

By default, press and hold "V" to view the calendar.
(Support binding key at bottom of Settings > Controls page)

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
This is a client-only mod, it only works if you're there when the boss is defeat.

[h3]Loot Stash[/h3]
Only works for gold chain version during Winter's Feast.

[h3]Malbatross[/h3]
By default world settings, it respawns after 5~15 days.
We take it as 15.

[h3]Terrarium[/h3]
Once the twins have been summoned at least once, if a single night is spent without summoning them again, the Terrarium immediately enters its dormant state.
We are not detecting this situation.

[h3]Nightmare Werepig / Scrappy Werepig[/h3]
At the moment of next day coming, if the defeated variant is still existing in another player's sight, respawn will delay a whole day.
We have no way to detect this situation.

[h3]Frostjaw[/h3]
Timer only starts when trading with it, earlier than its actual despawn.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*]Boas: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1964575060]original author[/url]
[*]xaT2x: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2990298008]second contributor[/url]
[*]iaman2b: refined hi-res images, test
[*]Huxi: Loot Stash opening detect, Boss death detect
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: More Useful BOSS Spoils
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
I often see people saying that they have played for hundreds of hours and have not beaten the boss several times. I think the difficulty of the boss is on the one hand, and on the other hand, the property of the boss's drops makes people not interested in attacking the fortress! This mod is designed to strengthen the drops of various monsters, and match the corresponding drop strength according to the difficulty of the monsters! 
At the same time, this mod has enhanced some unpopular equipment, and the good-looking skin has no strength to use, which makes my heart hurt!
If you think the changes in this mod satisfy you, please like and collect! Let more people see this mod, and let more people have the motivation to attack the behemoth!
There is English translation in the discussion area, for English players! I hope this all helps!
[h1]The last update date for the English translated post was October 2022, and many of the information has expired. If you want to obtain the latest information, you can use the Chinese English translation software to translate the "All Change Description" in Chinese. Please forgive my poor English![/h1]

Устали гоняться за боссами или хотите знать, рядом ли они? Тогда не смотрите дальше.

Этот мод добавляет боссам индикатор, похожий на игрока, чтобы узнать, прячутся ли они поблизости, так что вы можете пойти и ударить их по лицу - или убежать от них, прежде чем они подойдут слишком близко. Этот индикатор может отображать боссов на расстоянии до 3–4 экранов, расстояние до которых зависит от размера их значка (более крупный значок = ближе). На данный момент отслеживаются следующие боссы:

Deerclops
Стрекоза
Bearger
Лось / гусь
Муравейник
Древний страж
Поганка (и кепка, и собственно босс)
Клаус
Сундук с добычей

Tired of chasing after bosses or want to know if they’re near? Then look no further.

What this mod does
This mod adds a player-like indicator to bosses to know if they’re lurking around, so that you can go and smack them in their face – or run away from them before they get too close. publishedfiledetails.title: Blitzo [Helluva Boss]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Here we go again..


The leader of I.M.P himself has ended up in The Constant and now must try to survive long enough to find the others.. or, a way out.


Stats:

Health: 300
Hunger: 200
Sanity: 180

Slow health regeneration at the cost of faster depleting hunger.

Slower than Moxxie & Millie.

Can craft his flintlock & more ammo for it. It's a powerful weapon in this world, being a firearm. However as a result, the materials needed are quite expensive.

Can read and craft Wickerbottom's books. Who says he wouldn't have picked up a thing or two about magical tomes from Stolas?

As always, let me know if anything with the grammar is off or any problems arise! Enjoy!


Just as before, two great close friends helped bring this mod to life and it wouldn't have been possible without them!

Puffy did the art for the torso as well as the portrait for Blitzo and the mod's menu icon!

D3rpy provided plenty of feedback during testing, general emotional support and helped me make sure the thumbnail and artwork looked just right!

publishedfiledetails.title: Boss enhance
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
🎯 Custom Boss Difficulty System
• Individual HP Scaling: Set unique health multipliers for each Boss (x0.1 to x10), with changes applying in real-time.
• Dynamic Difficulty: Adjust Boss HP for multiplayer sessions to fine-tune the challenge level.
• Full Coverage: Health modifications also apply to already spawned Bosses.
NEW!!! • Maximum health increases with the number of days.(suggest by @znak ) !!!

• Damage Multiplier System: Independently adjust Boss damage (x0.5 to x5).
• Special Balance Options: Includes x1.2 multiplier for slightly boosting high-attack Bosses.
• Extreme Scaling Support: Toadstool specifically supports ultra-low x0.1 multiplier.

🎁 Enhanced Loot System
• Additional Drops: Bosses can drop extra loot including gems, staves, crockpot dishes, and other valuable items.
• Independent Multipliers: Loot multiplier (x1 to x8) applies separately from added items.
• Dual Reward Mechanism: Base loot x8 multiplier + additional rare items.

🌍 Comprehensive Compatibility
• Multi-language Support: Seamlessly adapts to Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and Russian.
• Major Mod Support: Fully compatible with popular mods like "Never Compromise" and "Eternal New World".

publishedfiledetails.title: Fizzarolli [Helluva Boss]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
From one hell to another, now this performer must survive against all odds.

Fizz has arrived and he's here to stay guys! This circus clown's gonna be playing more of a supportive role compared to his more combat ready companions. Not to say he's not capable of surviving himself! He's just as capable as the others, ya just gotta get a bit creative with how you handle bigger enemies.

Unfortunately his hat hangs down over his arms and causes his arms to be hidden beneath it's twin tails. This causes his arms to appear hidden in some animations due to perspectives, but they're still there! Hope that's not an issue with you guys, unfortunately making new animations to get around this is beyond my skillset.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Health = 130

Hunger = 180

Sanity = 200

- Has his own custom lantern! Ozzie taught him how to make his own little light for use during performances, now it's about to get a lot more useful. Use twigs and flammable objects to refuel when needed! Lose your lantern? No problem! You can craft a new one in the crafting menu in his icon.

- Emote to restore sanity to both yourself, and surrounding players! Fizz is a performer after all. Beware though, it takes a lot of energy with all those stunts, costs 20 hunger each time.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Back to the workbench we go with the next character in my mod lineup! Decided to bring Fizz to life after several scenes and new developments with him made him more of my favorite character! Hope you guys enjoy this rendition of him.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

These two are back, back again! Plenty of thanks to them for all the work they've helped with.

D3rpy for testing, balancing, and of course art style feedback and character design! He helped make sure it looked perfect and there were no issues with making everything fit. 

Puffy for making the icons, body texture, and of course, ideas and help with the traits and stats! She also helped test Work In Progress builds and made sure everything works well.

Beta Testers - QuilNorth & TheSkreachingCat
-------------------------------------

This may be my last Helluva Boss mod for awhile, if there's another character that catches my interest within it though, I may make them! But for now, I'd like to take a break from making these kinds of characters, plus, I've got ideas for some others if I have the time!

I won't quit making them, I'm just making other things for now!

publishedfiledetails.title: Millie [Helluva Boss]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This isn't the first time she's had to save her love.



Millie from Helluva Boss has now been plucked straight from Hell and taken to The Constant. She'll do everything she can to find her love again. (Or, survive with him if he happens to be there!)

Millie is meant to be similar to Moxxie but with more stable base stats at the trade off of having half of his benefits.

Stats:

Health: 165
Hunger:150
Sanity: 150

1.2x additional damage in combat.

Slightly faster walk speed but slower than Moxxie.

Starts with a spear!
